description_en: Updates the tenant-level memory configuration for the current account based on the agent provider, business platform, and business type
description_zh: 按 Agent 提供方、业务平台和业务类型修改当前账号的租户级记忆配置
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center modify-tenant-memory-config --agent-provider OpenClaw --agent-platform ENTERPRISE --biz-type 1 --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyTenantMemoryConfig

parameters.help_en: The agent provider. This parameter is used together with AgentPlatform and BizType to locate the memory configuration. You must use a configured business combination
parameters.help_zh: Agent 提供方。与 AgentPlatform、BizType 一起定位记忆配置，须使用已配置的业务组合
parameters.name: agent_provider

parameters.help_en: The business platform to which the agent belongs. Specify the platform that corresponds to the tenant memory configuration, such as `ENTERPRISE` for the enterprise platform
parameters.help_zh: Agent 所属业务平台。填写与租户记忆配置对应的平台，例如企业平台 `ENTERPRISE`
parameters.name: agent_platform

parameters.help_en: The business type code. This parameter is used together with the provider and business platform. Common values include `1` (Enterprise Edition), `10` (Personal Edition), and `20` (Commercial Edition)
parameters.help_zh: 业务类型编码。与提供方和业务平台一起使用。常见值包括 `1`（企业版）、`10`（个人版）、`20`（商业版）
parameters.name: biz_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the memory feature for the business combination is enabled. A value of `true` enables the feature, and `false` disables the feature. If this parameter is omitted, the current setting is retained
parameters.help_zh: `true` 表示启用该业务组合的记忆功能，`false` 表示关闭。省略时保留当前开关
parameters.name: enabled

schema.description_en: The response of the API call
schema.description_zh: 本次 API 调用的响应结果

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于排查问题
